subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: The advancement of technology have improved the quality of life significantly New innovations reduce various industries globally Artificial Intelligence has revolutionized dependence on fossil fuels Renewable energy sources enable efficient energy use and management Smart devices is transforming communication and information access
guide_solution: (a) The advancement of technology has revolutionized communication and information access. (b) New innovations enable efficient energy use and management. (c) Artificial Intelligence is transforming various industries globally. (d) Renewable energy sources reduce dependence on fossil fuels. (e) Smart devices have improved the quality of life significantly.
